meta.source_name: Texas Legislature Online and certified Texas House Journals
meta.purpose: Machine-readable verified voting records for the Talarico Then & Now archival website.
meta.status: verified starter dataset with record-type labeling
meta.scope_note: Verified starter dataset. It now includes official records located through primary-source research and secondary scorecard leads; it is not yet a complete career roll-call database.
notes: Committee votes and final House votes are identified separately.
A vote is never inferred from party, sponsorship, attendance, or a voice vote.
Absence entries come directly from official committee minutes.
Key-vote labeling highlights politically significant measures or final floor passage, not an editorial judgment on the merits.

votes.description: SB 763, allowing public schools to employ or accept volunteer chaplains, passed the House 89-58-1. Talarico is listed among the Nays.

votes.notes: Certified House Journal, Record 1383.

votes.action_es: Votación del pleno de la Cámara.

votes.action: Third reading and final passage
votes.description: HB 222, relating to permissible uses of the school safety allotment under the Foundation School Program, passed 91-55-1. Talarico is listed among the Yeas.
votes.source_label: Texas Legislature Online / Texas House Journal
votes.notes: Certified House Journal, Record 306.
votes.description_es: HB 222, relacionado con usos permitidos de la asignación de seguridad escolar, fue aprobado 91-55-1. Talarico aparece entre los votos a favor.
votes.action_es: Votación del pleno de la Cámara.

votes.action: House floor vote on Amendment No. 72 to CSHB 1
votes.action_es: Votación del pleno sobre la Enmienda Núm. 72 a CSHB 1
votes.description: Amendment No. 72 directed the Health and Human Services Commission to seek a Medicaid waiver expanding eligibility to the maximum extent permitted by federal law. The amendment failed 66-80, with 2 present not voting. Talarico is listed among the Yeas.
votes.description_es: La Enmienda Núm. 72 ordenaba a la Comisión de Salud y Servicios Humanos solicitar una exención de Medicaid para ampliar la elegibilidad al máximo permitido por la ley federal. La enmienda fracasó 66-80, con 2 presentes sin votar. Talarico aparece entre los votos a favor.
votes.source_label: Certified Texas House Journal
votes.notes: Official House Journal Record 107. Identified as a research lead through a 2019 Club for Growth Foundation scorecard, then independently verified.

votes.action: Third reading and final House passage
votes.action_es: Tercera lectura y aprobación final en la Cámara
votes.description: HB 14 concerned state support for development of the nuclear energy industry. It passed the House 134-9, with 1 present not voting. Talarico is listed among the Yeas.
votes.description_es: HB 14 trató sobre apoyo estatal al desarrollo de la industria de energía nuclear. Fue aprobado por la Cámara 134-9, con 1 presente sin votar. Talarico aparece entre los votos a favor.
votes.source_label: Certified Texas House Journal
votes.notes: Official House Journal Record 371. Identified as a research lead through the 2025 Sierra Club Texas scorecard, then independently verified.

votes.action: Third reading and final House passage
votes.action_es: Tercera lectura y aprobación final en la Cámara
votes.description: HB 5246 concerned the Texas Space Commission and related aerospace and space-exploration entities. It passed the House 123-8, with 1 present not voting. Talarico is listed among the Yeas.
votes.description_es: HB 5246 trató sobre la Comisión Espacial de Texas y entidades relacionadas con actividades aeroespaciales y de exploración espacial. Fue aprobado por la Cámara 123-8, con 1 presente sin votar. Talarico aparece entre los votos a favor.
votes.source_label: Certified Texas House Journal
votes.notes: Official House Journal Record 1317. The 2025 Sierra Club scorecard marks Talarico N on this item, but the certified House Journal lists him among the Yeas. Sierra states its scorecard may adjust votes based on stated intent; this database follows the certified journal.
